x-overlay-note: Corrections to openapi/finance.json, applied by tools/generate.mjs as an RFC 7386 merge patch.
The document marks every filter on /transactions optional. The service requires one of them,
and says so in a 400 rather than returning an unfiltered page:
OrderNumber, PackageNumber, ReferenceDocument, Sku  --  if one of these parameters is empty,
you must enter a date filter. (RecordDateStart - RecordDateEnd) OR (DueDateStart - DueDateEnd)
So `Offset`/`Limit` alone -- the only two parameters the document marks required -- is a 400.
The date pairs are ISO-8601 here, not the yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm the OMS filters take; a seven-day
RecordDateStart/RecordDateEnd window in that form was answered with 200.

get.x-observed-note: A query carrying only Offset and Limit is refused with 400 and the message quoted above. One of the listed identifiers, or one complete date pair, must be supplied.
